parts.text: When the seagulls follow the trawler,
it's because they think sardines will be thrown into the sea.

posters.speaker: Eric Cantona, press conference after his appeal, 31 March 1995. Press transcriptions print 'it is'; the poster uses 'it's' (founder, 4 Oct 2026: 'use contractions').

parts.text: I never wanted Manchester United to be second to anybody.
Only the best would be good enough.
If you're good enough, you're old enough.

posters.speaker: Attributed to Sir Matt Busby (the Busby Babes youth policy); no primary source found, so never claimed as a direct quote in copy.
Terrace anthem; the 1983 record's verses are someone's copyright, so only the three-word refrain is used.
